heading: Website
intro: Edit the website's home page, notice banners, help pages and questions for each market and language. Pick the market and language first. A version goes live at 00:00 Romanian time on its show-from date, and every publish is in the audit log.
auditLink: See every website change in the audit log
markdownHint: Use **bold**, *italics*, ## headings, lists and [links](/help). Links to our own pages start with /.
showFromHint: Today goes live within a minute. A later date goes live at 00:00 Romanian time that day, and the current version stays up until then. Save draft changes nothing on the website.

problems.not_in_headline: Pick a word that is in the headline.
problems.invalid: This can't be saved like this.
problems.bad_address: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens only, up to 60.
problems.before_show_from: Pick a day after it goes live.
problems.placeholders_changed: Keep the same placeholders (the chips in the preview) as the default text.
problems.brand_name: Don’t type the product or company name: use the same placeholder as the default text, so a rename changes it everywhere.
problems.before_start: Pick a last day on or after the first day.
problems.longer_than_a_year: Something that comes back every year can last a year at most.

failures.not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can edit the website.
failures.invalid: This can't be saved like this.
failures.not_found: That version no longer exists. Reload the page.
failures.unreachable: We couldn't reach the database. Check your connection and try again.
failures.bad_address: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens only, up to 60.
failures.unknown_kind: This kind of content doesn't exist.
failures.unknown_language: That language isn't one of this market's languages.
failures.home_page_stays: The home page can be replaced but not removed.

outcomes.save: Draft saved. Nothing has changed for visitors yet.
outcomes.restore: The earlier version is back as a draft. Publish it to put it live.
outcomes.remove: Taken down. It no longer shows on the website.
outcomes.reset: Back to the default text from today.
outcomes.occasionSaved: Saved. Readers see the change within a minute.
outcomes.occasionRemoved: Removed from the schedule. Readers see the change within a minute.

home.sectionsLegend: Why write here, safety and questions

rightsCard.title: “Your rights” card: title (leave the card empty to hide it)

fields.footerNote: Footer: a few words about the site

home.bandsLegend: Bands lower down and the footer

notices.none: No notices in this market yet.
notices.linkHint: One of our own pages, starting with /, for example /discover.
notices.showUntilHint: It comes down at 00:00 Romanian time that day.

help.heading: Help pages
help.addressHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. It can't change later.

legal.label: Legal wording (age, consent, privacy, reporting, messaging or money)
legal.reminder: This must say the same as the legal documents. If they disagree, the legal documents win and this page is fixed the same day.

emails.intro: Every email the platform sends, in Romanian and English. Placeholders (shown as chips in the preview, such as the link or the code) are locked: you can move them in the text but not remove or change them, or the email can’t be sent. Edits reach the emails once the email sender is switched on for this site.

interfaceText.searchHint: Search by the words on screen, in either language, or by key.

branding.heading: Logo and emblem
branding.intro: Upload the logo and the emblem for the light and the night theme. The emblem sits beside the name in the top bar and is the icon in the browser tab. Every picture is checked, and a moderator approves it before anyone else sees it; until then the app keeps showing what it shows now. Every change is in the audit log.
branding.hint: PNG or WebP with a transparent background works best, up to 2 MB. It is resized to 1,024 px on its longest side.

logo_light.title: Logo, light theme
logo_light.where: Replaces the name in the top bar on the light theme. Without one, the name shows as text.

logo_dark.title: Logo, night theme
logo_dark.where: Replaces the name in the top bar on the night theme. Without one, the name shows as text.

emblem_light.title: Emblem, light theme
emblem_light.where: Beside the name in the top bar on the light theme, and the browser tab icon when the browser is light.

emblem_dark.title: Emblem, night theme
emblem_dark.where: Beside the name in the top bar on the night theme, and the browser tab icon when the browser is dark.

states.checking_earlier: This picture is being checked. The earlier picture shows until a moderator approves it.
states.checking_default: This picture is being checked. The default shows until a moderator approves it.
states.waiting_for_person_earlier: This picture is waiting for a moderator. The earlier picture shows until then.
states.waiting_for_person_default: This picture is waiting for a moderator. The default shows until then.
states.removed_earlier: A moderator removed this picture. The earlier picture shows instead.
states.removed_default: A moderator removed this picture. The default shows instead.
